summary: Agent corrected the NPA status due to bank error.

intents.intent: Loan Account NPA Status Inquiry and Rectification
intents.keywords: I am so stressed...reported to CIBIL
issues: Loan account incorrectly marked as NPA (Non-Performing Asset)
Incorrect reporting to CIBIL (Credit Information Bureau of India Limited)
reasons (identified by agent): Payment was missed due to a bank error
actions of agent: Identified the cause of the NPA status
Confirmed it will be reported to CIBIL
intents.resolution: Agent corrected the NPA status and confirmed the updated status would be reported to CIBIL.
intents.agent professionalism: The agent was professional and addressed the customer's concern effectively.
